story.title: From Italy to Switzerland. The same passion since 2007.
story.p1: Casino Show brings to Switzerland the experience of Fun Casinò, the Italian project founded in 2007 by Davide Merli, professional croupier and European champion.
story.p2: Created to take the appeal of casino tables beyond gaming halls, Fun Casinò has developed over the years a format devoted to entertainment for corporate events, receptions and private occasions.
story.p3: With Casino Show, this experience extends to the Swiss market through a shared project, with the same attention to the quality of the setup, the preparation of the croupiers and the involvement of the guests.
story.p4: Two brands, two markets, one shared vision: to create elegant, engaging entertainment, without play for real money.
story.imageAlt: A croupier at a roulette table during an event.

davide.title: Davide Merli. Experience makes the difference.
davide.subtitle: Professional croupier, founder of Fun Casinò and European champion in 2012.
davide.p1: The story of Casino Show is tied to the professional path of Davide Merli.
davide.p2: His career in the casino world begins in 1998, with training in Sanremo, and continues through professional experience in Italy and abroad.
davide.p3: From the United Kingdom to France and on to the Caribbean, Davide builds his skill directly at the gaming tables, also working in Switzerland at the Casino of Lugano and the Casino Admiral in Mendrisio.
davide.p4: In 2007 he founds Fun Casinò, bringing the professional culture of the casino into entertainment for events.
davide.p5: In 2012, in Helsinki, he wins the European title at the European Dealer Championship, a recognition that marks his professional path.
davide.p6: This experience is one of the foundations of Casino Show: attention to the guests, preparation, precision and the ability to turn play into a shared moment of entertainment.
davide.imageAlt: Davide Merli with the European Dealer Championship trophy.

staff.title: People make the evening.
staff.p1: Behind every Casino Show event is a team of professionals chosen for their skill, their presence and their ability to involve the guests.
staff.p2: Our croupiers do more than run the tables. They welcome participants, explain the rules and help create an atmosphere that is elegant, lively and open to people who have never played.
staff.p3: Every event is different. The team is therefore composed according to the venue, the tables planned, the number of guests and the experience to be created.
